text:
naomi-pm: Quick sync — I want to align on Q3 observability priorities for Console. Customers keep pushing on retention per-route + better trace->error linking. We need to decide what lands in the core OKR vs deferred to post-launch experiments.

mira-eng: +1. From infra POV retention is the biggest cost risk. We can do sampling + TTL tiers, but per-route retention adds complexity to billing and storage.

jon-eng: Suggest we split into two deliverables: 1) dashboard & trace UX improvements (low infra impact) and 2) retention policy engine (higher infra effort). Can we make (1) a hard Q3 ship and (2) a Q4 scoped feature with a beta?

olivia-data: For retention policies we need schema for route tags and event metadata. Also want to estimate storage delta: naive per-route retention w/o sampling looks like 3-4x data growth for some customers.

kai-design: For dashboards, we can reuse the new panel components from the metrics redesign to surface trace error hotspots. Prototype ready — need eng time to wire the drilldowns. Sharing Figma: https://redwood.design/figma/obs-hotspots

diego-ux: Important: make error-to-trace navigation 1 click, not 3. Users keep saying they lose context. Small interaction change + a compact trace timeline should cut lookup time dramatically.

naomi-pm: OK can we map this to launch criteria? My proposal: must-have for Q3: (A) dashboard error hotspot panel + 1-click trace link, (B) basic sampling config (global + org-level) to avoid cost spikes, (C) clear rollout plan and docs. Stretch for Q3: per-route retention + per-route billing.

mira-eng: Implementation thoughts: we build sampling in the pipeline (pre-ingest) and add annotations so UI can show sampled vs full. Quick pseudo: ```json
{"sampling": {"default_rate": 0.1, "overrides": {"/payments": 1.0}}}``` This gives us fast wins.

jon-eng: For per-route retention we need a metadata propagation for requests and a cheap index to find retained traces. That's at least 3 sprint work. OK to mark as Q4.

olivia-data: If we do sampling, we must surface sampling bias metrics in the UI (samples per route, estimated true error rate). Otherwise customers will mistrust numbers.

kai-design: Happy to add sampling overlays to panels — mockups by EOD.

naomi-pm: Customer asks that triggered this: AcmeHealth and ShopWave asked for 90/30 retention split (90d errors, 30d traces) per route on critical endpoints. We should treat that as enterprise requirement (Private/Dedicated customers) and document limits for Hosted.

mira-eng: Agree to enterprise gating. Hosted will get sampling + org-level retention tiers; Dedicated/Private can apply per-route retention as an opt-in feature (config + price).

jon-eng: Can someone own the OKR wording? Proposed: "Reduce mean time to detect and diagnose production errors by 25% via dashboards, trace-error linking, and retention policies." Thoughts?

diego-ux: Love it. Add a leading indicator: "Increase users using 1-click trace from dashboard by 40%" as a secondary metric.

olivia-data: Data metric: surface sampling bias under 'Observability > Data Quality' and track estimated true error rate variance.

naomi-pm: Good. Let's finalize scope: Core Q3 scope (ship): dashboard hotspot panel, 1-click trace link, global/org sampling config, docs + rollout plan, acceptance criteria/tests. Deferred Q3 stretch -> per-route retention and per-route billing (Q4).

mira-eng: I'll write a tech spec for sampling + ingestion changes by Wed.

jon-eng: I'll scope trace linking changes and send an estimate (2-3 sprints) by Thu.

kai-design: I'll upload final mocks and a short interaction spec by EOD tomorrow.

naomi-pm: Thanks — I'll update the OKR draft and ping stakeholders for approval. If anyone objects to the split, raise here. :thumbsup:

sre-bot: Deploy alert: staging deployment for obs-hotspots succeeded (build 2025.11.3) :rocket:
